Salary on the 1st, gone by the 10th?

The 50/30/20 rule splits take-home pay: 50% needs, 30% wants, 20% savings.
The trick is order: move the 20% out automatically on salary day, then spend what's left.
Illustrative: on ₹50,000 take-home, ₹10,000 leaves on day 1.
